quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on his defensive role guarding top players
quotes.excerpt: That's my role. It's extremely important for us. I know that probably everybody knows me for scoring
quotes.quote: That's my role. It's extremely important for us. I know that probably everybody knows me for scoring, but now it's time to show other things as well, especially on defensive. I'm very curious about how is that defense going to look for me at the end of the season, where is it going to rank me. That's a personal challenge. I even told Mike G and Kenny, just let me guard the best and then it will help us because we can get into more switching.
quotes.social_post: Mario Hezonja is embracing a new defensive challenge this season, telling the coaching staff to let him guard the best players to help the team switch more effectively

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on his personal growth and team sacrifice
quotes.excerpt: It is a mega sacrifice, it's a totally different story going from being a volume guy
quotes.quote: It is a mega sacrifice, it's a totally different story going from being a volume guy there and being number one to here. I finished the first half with zero, but I don't care because the points for me, that's what I do. So that comes to me as a product of having great teammates around me, so I have to give them something which is now rebounding, which is defense, which is passing, playing, moving the ball, being smart about it.
quotes.social_post: Mario Hezonja on his role change with the Cavs: It is a mega sacrifice going from being a volume scorer to focusing on rebounding, defense, and moving the ball

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on the team's response to injuries
quotes.excerpt: It's a pity to see that our people are missing games, regardless of the situation
quotes.quote: It's a pity to see that our people are missing games, regardless of the situation of the bigger injury, small injury, protection, or whatever it is. Nobody wants to see that. We want everybody on the court. But for me, just being ready since I came here, since the first day, training or training camp, preseason, or now season, same mentality. quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on the challenges of rebounding in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: There is also a differentiability of the basketball in NBA because so many threes are being shot
quotes.quote: There is also a differentiability of the basketball in NBA because so many threes are being shot nowadays. So that ball is going to fly sometimes. You go a couple possessions up and down, obviously your energy tank is at that time not at 100%. So like you kind of find yourself in a bad spot, you're tagging your player that you're guarding, but that ball just goes over you. So the moment those couple of possessions we waste or like the ball goes out of bounds, it's a minus for us.
quotes.social_post: Mario Hezonja explains the difficulty of rebounding in the modern NBA, noting that the high volume of three point attempts makes long rebounds unpredictable
